sealLabel: Read your letter before you begin
paragraphs: Welcome to the Pintland Isles! Home of the finest brew anyone e'er drank. So you want to found a tavern do ya? Good business in these parts, but also rife with competition innit.
Will you become the largest brewer in the land? Perhaps yours will be the new name of beer itself.
Pick a town to start your pour and build a tavern that stands the field sobriety test of time.
